item.title: Congressman Harris Urges NOAA to Declare Economic Fishery Disaster
item.description: MARYLAND – United States Representative Andy Harris sent a letter on Wednesday to the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA), requesting that the agency declare an economic fishery disaster. Under the Magnuson-Stevens Fishery Conservation and Management Act, declaring a economic fishery disaster would authorize federal emergency relief for fisheries affected.
